description: camt.053 Bank to Customer Statement with 6 transaction entries demonstrating various entry types. Shows repeating Ntry elements with different transaction codes and party details.
test_coverage: Complete group header and statement header
Legal sequence number and from/to date range
Account with owner name and servicer details
Multiple balance types (OPBD opening, CLBD closing, CLAV available)
Transaction summary totals (6 entries: 4 credits, 2 debits)
Repeating Ntry elements (6 entries) with different transaction types
Related parties (debtor/creditor with names and IBANs)
Balance consistency validation (opening + credits - debits = closing)
business_rules_expected_to_pass: CAMT053-DT01: Value dates not in future
CAMT053-DT02: Booking dates not in future
CAMT053-CY01: Valid ISO 4217 currency codes for entries
CAMT053-CY02: Valid ISO 4217 currency codes for balances
CAMT053-IB01: Valid IBAN format (FR and DE IBANs pass Mod-97)
CAMT053-RF02: Entry references present for all entries
CAMT053-TS01: Total entry count consistency (6 entries)
notes: This statement demonstrates a typical business day for 'Société Exemple SARL' (a French company) with BNP Paribas. The account shows 6 different transaction types: incoming transfers from customers, a standing order credit, a check debit, a larger trade payment, a direct debit for utilities, and interest credit. The closing available balance (20,500.00) is less than the closing booked balance (21,250.00), indicating EUR 750 is held/reserved. This is semantically equivalent to an MT940 message with multiple field 61+86 repeating entries.
